titleStmt.title: Strong's Greek Dictionary
A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Greek Testament, with their Renderings in the Authorized English Version
titleStmt.author: James Strong

availability.licence: Public domain. James Strong's dictionary (1890) is in the public domain, and Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen released this edition under the Creative Commons CC0 waiver (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Converted to TEI by Bible Nav, with the corrections listed below.

sourceDesc.bibl: Strong's Greek Dictionary in XML with real Greek, version 1.9 (2019-02-05), prepared by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen from Michael Grier's 1996 e-text, with Unicode Greek corrected against the printed edition and later proofreading, as published by MorphGNT: https://github.com/morphgnt/strongs-dictionary-xml/blob/dd6758b82f46b620804a8ea677d715844679eea1/strongsgreek.xml (commit dd6758b82f46b620804a8ea677d715844679eea1, 2019-02-05), file SHA-256 91474213b208a4e487d35f85c10e5c90737acc69082dad15dec5431406003545.
James Strong, A Concise Dictionary of the Words in the Greek Testament, in The Exhaustive Concordance of the Bible (New York: Hunt & Eaton, 1890).

encodingDesc.p: Each entry is one of Strong's numbered entries; its xml:id is the Strong's number (G1 to G5624). The headword (orth) is the source's Unicode Greek, followed by its transliteration and Strong's pronunciation. A note of type forms gives alternative forms of the headword; etym holds Strong's derivation, def his definition, the note of type kjvRenderings his renderings in the King James Version, and a note of type comment his remarks after them. A ref links to another entry by number and shows that entry's headword (a link into Strong's Hebrew points into eng_strongs_heb.tei.xml); mentioned is a Greek word, with its transliteration (bn:translit) and pronunciation (bn:pron), or a pronunciation alone; foreign xml:lang="la" is a Latin word.

The source's line breaks, from a 1996 e-text wrapped at 72 columns, are not kept: white space runs are one space, each part is trimmed, and a word hyphenated at a line end is joined. The ":--" before the KJV renderings is left out; it is the section's heading in Bible Nav.
Left out from the source: the Beta Code spellings (BETA), and the 101 numbers Strong's left unused (G2717, G3203 to G3302), which hold only "Not Used".

revisionDesc.change: G912: "H5" corrected to "G5". Evidence: Strong (1890), Greek Dictionary, page 18, entry 912: "of Chald. or. [1347 and 5]; son of Abba", the 5 in italics (Greek: G5, Abba), the 1347 in roman type (Hebrew, kept as printed). Internet Archive, StrongsGreekAndHebrewDictionaries1890, StrongGreekDictionary, image n15.

G4567: "H4566" corrected to "G4566". Evidence: Strong (1890), Greek Dictionary, page 64, entry 4567: "of Chald. or. corresp. to 4566 (with the def. affix)", the number in italics (Greek: G4566, Satan), as is "the same as 4549" in entry 4569 below it, while the page's Hebrew numbers are roman, as in "[5429]" (entry 4568). Internet Archive, StrongsGreekAndHebrewDictionaries1890, StrongGreekDictionary, image n61.
